CVE-2026-9149.title: A flaw was found in libsolv. This heap buffer overflow vulnerabil ...
CVE-2026-9149.description: A flaw was found in libsolv. This heap buffer overflow vulnerability occurs when a victim processes a specially crafted `.solv` file containing negative size values in the `repo_add_solv` function. This leads to an undersized memory allocation and a subsequent out-of-bounds write. An attacker could exploit this to cause a denial of service (DoS).

CVE-2026-9150.title: A flaw was found in libsolv. This stack-based buffer overflow vul ...
CVE-2026-9150.description: A flaw was found in libsolv. This stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability occurs in libsolv's Debian metadata parser when processing specially crafted Debian repository metadata. An attacker could exploit this by providing malicious SHA384 or SHA512 checksum tags, leading to memory corruption and a denial of service (DoS) in the affected system.
